summary: Edit the rh-certified remote (Automation Content > Remotes) with the Sync URL and token from console.redhat.com to sync certified collections; by default it covers all certified collections, or upload a requirements file to limit it (new collections must be added to it). Needs Modify Ansible repo content permission and port 443.
questions: How do I sync certified collections to private automation hub?
Where do I get the Sync URL for rh-certified?
How do I sync only some certified collections?
What permissions are needed to edit a remote?

answer_card.title: Configure the rh-certified remote
answer_card.answer_md:
1. On console.redhat.com get the **Sync URL** and **API token**.
2. **Automation Content > Remotes** → *rh-certified* → **Edit remote**.
3. Paste URL and Token → **Save remote**.

Needs *Modify Ansible repo content* permission and outbound **443**. To sync only selected collections, add a requirements file to the remote; add any new collection to it explicitly.
